title: Phase 0 teachers: the BDP rule and a TD3+BC policy, as ONNX graphs
description: The two teachers of Phase 0 (docs/methodology.md), copied byte for byte from the project compact was forked from, so that compact's experiments read them from compact's own releases. teachers/rule-bdp.onnx is a fixed rule: a window of 2^0.25 times the bandwidth-delay product its built-in estimator believes (source: release model-net1v5 of Radonux/palaestra, file rule-u0.25.onnx). teachers/td3bc.onnx is a policy trained offline with TD3+BC on its built-in estimator's outputs (source: release model-net1v3, file learned-td3bc-n40-s0.onnx). Both act through an estimator of seven path quantities, so they test recovery of a known bottleneck, not discovery. Each graph takes a batch of 1. summary.md lists each file's size and SHA-256.
collect: { echo '| file | bytes | sha256 |'; echo '|---|---|---|'; for f in "$OUT"/teachers/*.onnx; do echo "| teachers/$(basename "$f") | $(stat -c %s "$f") | $(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1) |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
